meta.name: kpi-dashboard-design
meta.description: Design effective KPI dashboards with metrics selection, visualization best practices, and real-time monitoring patterns. Use this skill when building an executive SaaS metrics dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC ratios; designing an operations center with live service health and request throughput; creating a cohort retention analysis view for a product team; or debugging a dashboard where metrics contradict each other due to inconsistent calculation methodology.

copy.tagline: 设计出反映业务关键指标的优质仪表板
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要为客户或团队搭建业务数据看板
copy.tagline_en: Design a clear dashboard for your key business metrics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build a clear data dashboard for your business.

howto.what: Claude 会按 KPI 框架陪你设计仪表盘:挑选指标、规划分层布局与实时监控方式,并排查指标数字互相矛盾背后的计算口径问题。
howto.when: 当你做高管指标仪表盘、运营实时监控视图,或需要排查指标口径不一致等问题时接管。

say.text: 帮我设计一个跟踪 MRR、流失率和 LTV/CAC 的高管仪表盘
say.note: 会先确定指标口径再排布局

say.text: 我的看板 MRR 和财务的数字对不上,帮我查原因
say.note: 会比对年付、季付的折算公式

say.text: 给产品团队做一个按注册月份分组的留存队列视图
say.note: 会检查队列是否按月分组

howto.what_en: Claude designs KPI dashboards with you: selecting metrics, arranging layered layouts and real-time monitoring, and debugging dashboards whose numbers conflict due to inconsistent calculation methods.
howto.when_en: Use when building executive SaaS metric dashboards, operations live-monitoring views, or cohort retention views, or when debugging a dashboard where metrics contradict each other.
